text:
jen_partnerships: quick sync — VaultStream (SI) reached out; they want to list a bundled offering in the MSSP marketplace that pairs Redwood Private + VaultStream secrets manager. asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM keywrap demo by EOW. can we do an end-to-end smoke and a 1-pager runbook? @samir_eng @lee_security :eyes:

samir_eng: I can take the E2E smoke. what's the exact scope for KMS? symmetric key wrap or full HSM signing?

jen_partnerships: primary ask is keywrap for secrets-at-rest rotation (they call it "key wrapping" in their spec). also need SAML assertions sample and SCIM user sync example. timeline is tight — partner marketing wants demo in their webinar next week. :alarm_clock:

lee_security: keywrap is ok but we need to vet the HSM integration pattern. for Private we'll do a customer-managed KMS flow (bring-your-own-key). we should confirm VaultStream's KMS vendor (they mentioned KeyWave) and whether they support KMIP. also need threat-model notes for cross-tenant key access. cc @samir_eng

samir_eng: noted. I'll spin up a test Private instance in the staging VPC and do a mock KMS handshake. quick check: do we have an existing KMIP test harness?

jen_partnerships: not a public one. ops has a KMIP emulator image we can use. @olivia_sales said partner can provide a test tenant for VaultStream side.

olivia_sales: confirmed — VaultStream will provision a dev tenant and a preprod KMS endpoint (non-prod certs). they asked for an integration checklist so they can prep keys and service accounts.

samir_eng: ok putting together steps. rough plan: 1) SAML metadata exchange, 2) SCIM token + sample group sync, 3) KMS keywrap test with KMIP endpoint, 4) secrets rotation smoke using our rotate API. I'll post commands.

samir_eng: curl example for SCIM token retrieval:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.vaultstream.example/scim/token -d '{"client_id":"vaultstream-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

lee_security: for SAML please use signed assertions in the demo and a snapshot of our IdP metadata. do not include real certs in the runbook; use placeholders. also add an attack surface note about provisioning tokens with long TTLs.

jen_partnerships: agreed on placeholders. marketing wants a short "how it works" blurb and a diagram. can we deliver a 1-page runbook + 5-slide intro for the webinar?

maria_pm: I can draft the 1-pager and slides if eng gives me the commands and a couple of screenshots by Wednesday.

samir_eng: I'll aim to have the smoke logs and a short script by Tuesday evening. sample rotate API call:
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"secret_id":"vs-test-secret","kms_key_id":"kmip://test-key"}'
```

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #vaultstream-integ smoke-tests completed — 7 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM group sync timeout). log: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/1234 :white_check_mark:

samir_eng: saw the timeout. increasing SCIM sync page size caused a failure in vaultstream staging. switching to incremental sync and retry with exponential backoff.

lee_security: also add an idempotency token for group provisioning to avoid duplicates during retries.

jen_partnerships: thanks. action items: Samir (E2E smoke + script) — due Tue EOD; Maria (runbook + slides) — Wed EOD; Olivia (partner tenant + certs) — Wed morning; Lee (security blurb + threat model) — Wed EOD. marketing wants final assets by Thu for joint announcement prep.

olivia_sales: I'll push partner to deliver the dev certs by tomorrow morning.

maria_pm: putting a calendar invite for Thurs 10am rehearsal with VaultStream product + marketing. invite sent.

samir_eng: sharing temporary repo with scripts: https://git.internal/redwood/vaultstream-integ (internal only)

lee_security: quick reminder — include a rollback procedure if rotation fails (revert to old wrapping key and mark secrets read-only).

jen_partnerships: perfect. we'll consolidate into the runbook. thanks team :rocket:
